population_description: Synthetic design records supplied as the complete declared RDF-class population in each input. External legal/application eligibility and experimental edition selection are caller research assumptions, not inferred RDF facts or real-vessel certification. Records may be incomplete, inconsistent or contain unrecognized values. Conditions within the represented requirement, missing represented inputs, activation, datatype/unit/path and logical correctness remain for generated SHACL to assess. Evaluation covers finite represented inventories, not reconstruction of unrecorded real-world persons/components; this does not authorize inventing existence requirements or treating a represented missing value as compliant. Stored plating thickness, required net-thickness reference and allowance records. The required net-thickness and allowance are supplied engineering references; upstream structural calculations and physical measurements are not reconstructed. Declared property-specific units and represented source conditions remain validation responsibilities.
